title: A ν-a.e. transversal constraint holds σ-a.e.: if x − p_V x ∈ Z for ν-a.e. x, then σ(ℝ^P∖Z) = 0
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim V = n (Module.finrank ℝ V = n), and p_V the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto V (V.starProjection). Let σ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P with σ(ℝ^P∖V^⊥) = 0, and ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(A) = ∫⁻_{t∈V}σ({y : t + y ∈ A}) dHⁿ(t) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Let Z ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set such that x − p_V x ∈ Z for ν-almost every x. Then σ(ℝ^P∖Z) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Z : Set (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]) → MeasurableSet Z → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x - V.starProjection x ∈ Z) → σ Zᶜ = 0
